reason: React Aria's OverlayArrow renders an extra wrapper div (data-slot=tooltip-arrow) positioned via a computed center-point + CSS translate(-50%). Reka's PopperArrow positions the arrow via floating-ui's top-left-corner math on an internal non-slot-exposed span, so there is no equivalent wrapper element to attach the data-slot to; only the inner svg (overlay-arrow) is emitted. Verified against the real open DOM on both sides; visual position matches via screenshot diff.
